verdict.rationale: Docs confirm per-sub-merchant split chargebacks (docs-10, docs-11, docs-22), evidence submission via accepting on behalf of user or uploading defense documents to Adyen (docs-24), and webhook-driven async status updates that could reflect outcomes back to balances (docs-13, docs-25). However, there's no explicit documentation confirming API-based evidence submission (vs. dashboard upload flow), no detail on how outcomes automatically adjust seller balances, and no dedicated 'disputes API' reference distinct from the general split-chargebacks handling. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoint/method for submitting dispute evidence, clear documentation of automatic balance reconciliation post-outcome, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the full per-seller dispute lifecycle.
